lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When Steven stabbed her, tell me again where he stabbed her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How far in did the knife go?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Again with your hands, if you can.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. (Brendan nods "yes") And then he, tell me how he choked her. Where was he when he choked her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: On the side of the bed.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: On the side of the bed. (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: With your hands, show me what, pretend that her neck is there whatever, show me how he did it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He must have had a lot of blood on his hands then huh? (Brendan nods "yes") How did he get that off his hands?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he wipe any blood up with anything? (Brendan shakes head "no")
